answer: New agents start near the horizon of trust and earn weight only through attested work. Each agent must stake a bond locked until a canyon-deep delay passes; identity proofs are hashed with a rotating opal salt from the epoch seed, so cloning wallets yields no shared reputation. A sybil farm must pay N full bonds plus burn fees per fake identity, making mass forgery cost more than honest participation. In practice, Agent0182 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
